info.title: Mastra Gateway v2
info.description: Public Gateway v2 API. Use a Gateway v2 key in Authorization: Bearer or x-api-key, or Bearer plus the key in X-Memory-Gateway-Authorization. A nonempty dedicated header takes precedence over provider OAuth. Conflicting gateway keys and nonempty malformed dedicated headers are refused. An empty dedicated header is treated as absent. Without a nonempty dedicated header, Authorization and x-api-key must match. Model capabilities and availability vary by region and policy. Request schemas describe validation inputs; custom refinements remain enforced by the gateway. Response fields follow the endpoint protocol and selected provider.

get.summary: Get the Gateway v2 OpenAPI document

200.description: Successful response. Managed usage.cost, when present, is the customer charge in USD; BYOK retains the provider-reported cost. Unknown customer charges omit cost.

500.description: Gateway refusal or sanitized upstream error, following the endpoint protocol. Gateway credit, budget, BYOK and rate refusal messages include a configurable dashboard help URL. Inference preserves the upstream HTTP status and allowed rate-limit metadata, never its raw body or free-form message. HTTP parser errors return generic JSON with a request ID (431 for header overflow, 408 for request receive timeout, 400 for malformed HTTP), before endpoint selection. If a response has already started, the connection closes without another HTTP response.
